notes: Two routes meet at Ayyub; the names after him are written once (in the second route) and are the shared tail for both
«قالا» joins Ahmad b. Manie and Ali b. Hujr into one level

The dashes around «عن عائشة» are read as text punctuation, since «عن النبي» needs her as the link; the remark «وقد أوقفه بعضهم» names no transmitter and «مائة فما فوقها» is a wording variant: both left out
